summary: Frontend-only verification of (A) Operasi Gudang hub consolidation (QC & Inspeksi + transfer sub-tabs), (B) Pengaturan hub picking up the 5 relocated settings tabs with their section headers, (C) status-tab + count + search uniformity on Kontrak Mitra & Supplier / PIN / Pengajuan Dana / Pertanggungjawaban, and (D) regression smoke of reorder, supplier-items, color-library, internal-prices. Tested as admin, manager, warehouse, salesadmin. 95% of acceptance criteria met. ONE deep-link bug found: ?view=inspections falls through to Beranda/Control Tower for admin instead of opening QcHubView on the docs sub-tab.

ui_bugs.issue: Admin navigation to /?view=inspections&entity=ent_ksc redirects to Beranda > Control Tower (sidebar highlights 'Beranda'); qc-hub-view / qc-hub-tab-docs are not rendered. The hidden-tab entry in hubTabs.js wms-operations ({view:'inspections', hidden:true}) is not wired to render QcHubView. Spec requires: 'Deep link ?view=inspections opens the same hub on the docs sub-tab.' ?view=qc-inspection works correctly (hub + queue sub-tab active).

action_items: Wire ?view=inspections to render QcHubView with initial='docs' (either in AppViewRouter or by aliasing the view-id in navigationConfig so the hidden tab actually resolves to QcHubView). Current behaviour: silent redirect to Beranda — users clicking old deep-links lose their place.
critical_code_review_comments: hubTabs.js wms-operations correctly declares the 4 top tabs (Stok/Transfer+Opname, Barang Masuk, Barang Keluar, QC & Inspeksi) and marks 'inspections' + 'interco-transfers' as hidden; the hidden flag suppresses them from the hub bar — verified. However only one of the two hidden deep-links is routed: interco-transfers would also fall through if used (not in test scope today but same risk).

OperationsView.jsx renders the entity sub-tab StatusTabs only when user.role is in IC_ROLES = [admin, warehouse, manager, warehouse_admin]. salesadmin is correctly excluded — sub-tabs disappear and only the warehouse transfer list is rendered. Good role gate.

settings-hub in hubTabs.js carries the 5 relocated views (cs-rfid-devices · return-policies · expense-categories · hr-attendance-setup · rnd-divisions) each with a correct 'section' label. Rendering as admin shows all 16 tabs including these; rendering as manager keeps the manager-permitted ones (incl. return-policies, expense-categories, hr-attendance-setup, rnd-divisions — admin-only cs-rfid-devices is not visible to manager and that matches the role array).

Salesadmin's settings-hub flows directly to return-policies and renders the content without a secondary tab bar — hub-tab-* count is 0 because only 1 tab is role-visible. UX is acceptable (breadcrumb 'Pengaturan · Penjualan · Kebijakan Retur Jual' is clear), but if more settings tabs become salesadmin-visible later, the tab bar will suddenly appear — consider always rendering it even for singletons for consistency.

StatusTabs implementation renders count badges inline (within the tab button) for supplier-contracts (verified 4 badges aligned to 4 filters). pin-tab/ca-tab/stl-tab also have StatusTabs tabs but the preview dataset in ent_ksc returned 0 rows so filter test could not assert row reduction; tabs + search inputs are present and reactive.
QcHubView.jsx composition is clean (lazy-loaded QCInspection + InspectionsView under StatusTabs). Only concern is the external deep-link alias not being wired.

success_rate.frontend: ~95% (18/19 acceptance checks pass; 1 fail on inspections deep-link)

rca of the issue: Deep-link ?view=inspections: the hubTabs.js entry for the 'wms-operations' hub marks inspections as {hidden:true} so it doesn't appear as a visible hub tab (correct). But the overall navigationConfig/AppViewRouter does NOT map the view-id 'inspections' to the <QcHubView initial='docs'/> component — so URL fall-through chooses the default landing (Beranda > Control Tower for admin). Fix: either (a) alias 'inspections' → QcHubView(initial='docs') in AppViewRouter, or (b) in navigationConfig re-export add a hidden-view mapping that routes 'inspections' through QcHubView with the appropriate initial prop. Same pattern likely applies to the sibling hidden entry 'interco-transfers' → should route to OperationsView(defaultTab='transfer', transferScope='entity').
